title: August and the Ghost
author: W. M. Almeida
blurb: Ulyana Okafor, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
